independenceDeclaration: This report was produced by an independent main-agent session distinct from Documentary Builder B. The auditor did not create, repair, reformat or reserialize P3, re-derived every PASS fact in this session from the authorized standalone source, the session-local clone, the exact P3 bytes and the Owner-supplied accepted R1/R2 text, and used R6 observations only as non-authoritative hints.

nonblockingFindings.summary: Machine-local builder checkout path retained as historical provenance; not consumed by canonical tooling; must not be treated as an operative root requirement by later missions.
DISTANCES_WITH_FROZEN_MODEL is a clarifying qualifier consistent with R1; no weakening because all distances run under a closed versioned model with TrainingCutoff.
Admission C cannot bind candidate bytes by design; publication mission must check P3 bytes against the sha256 recorded in this P4 before publisher invocation.

TrainingCutoff <= QueryKnowledgeCutoff for non-evaluation views is not written as an explicit inequality; it is enforced by NO_FUTURE_LEAKAGE=true, futureDataInputsAllowed=false and the calibration protocol, at the same level as accepted R1. Recommend Phase 2 specification states it explicitly.
The superseded P4 omitted the tracked governing constitution governance/PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.json. Provenance is corrected in this R7R1; retrospective compliance verified; no rule violated.

r6AdvisoryObservationResolutions.resolution: Historical builder-environment provenance only. The canonical authority/admission/publisher chain binds baseHead, ledger, gate pre-state and path prestates, never a checkout path (no canonical governance tool or core module reads "authorizedCheckout"). baseLock.baseHead/ledgerSha256 equal canonical facts re-derived in AUDIT_REPO_R7. The path is non-Desktop and is not a write target. Not an operative dependency for audit, admission or publication.

Neither R1, R2 nor the Owner decisions require P3 to name OWNER_RATIFY_JARVISE_DH_CF_R2_AND_AUTHORIZE_PREBUILD_AUTHORITY_R1 literally. P3 binds exact P2 bytes (sha256/byteLength/authorityId) and P2.resumePoint names that decision; P3 also names Owner Decision 2 and the architecture decision. The bound authority/decision chain is sufficient and tamper-evident.

Domain/version names are taken verbatim from accepted R1. Tracked governance/app at HEAD contain no AnalogueStateVector, SelectionPolicy/, AnalogueComparisonView or ComparisonModelManifest domains; GATE25 V1 uses distinct domain strings (SelectionPolicyVersion/1). The /2 suffix marks V2 generation; the domain string itself is part of every closed preimage, so no collision or ambiguity arises. ComparisonModelManifest/1 is a new domain.

Accepted R1/R2 require no standalone as-of timestamp for the contract. P3 anchors to baseHead, ledger count/sha and exact P1/P2 digests (all re-derived here), and every data use is bounded per input by availableAt(input) <= K(s) with K(s) = PinnedCanonicalSession(s).closeUtc (existing GATE23/GATE24 convention). A wall-clock as-of would add nondeterminism without adding causal protection.

All three only narrow. fixedPerTickerParameterTableAllowed=false forbids hand-fixed per-ticker tables while parametersSharedOrAdaptiveUnderVersionedModel=true keeps calibrated adaptation available (R1: parameters come from calibration). adaptiveBehavior is an unset calibration output, never a fixed choice. DISTANCES_WITH_FROZEN_MODEL reconciles two accepted R1 statements (labels never influence distances; model training may use outcomes available at its cutoff) exactly as R1 validation row "Outcomes modifiés, modèle/policy gelés -> État et sélection inchangés"; since every distance is computed under a closed, versioned ComparisonModelManifest/1 with TrainingCutoff, and selectionOutcomeInputsAllowed=false / futureDataInputsAllowed=false, no channel is opened. Additional restrictive tokens (MISSING_VOLUME_TO_ZERO, CROSS_VINTAGE_STITCHING, IMPLICIT_FORWARD_FILL, wallClockCutoffConstantsAllowed=false) are likewise narrowing.

observed.mutualBindingRule: Admission identity digest excludes the Owner registry back-reference; Owner registry binds admission identity digest; completed admission binds actual Owner registry file digest.

r6AdvisoryObservationResolutions.resolution: R2 orders B (P3 + independent P4) before C and publisher invocation that "vérifie A/C et les candidats". Canonical code confirms there is no admission candidate-byte field (admission binds authority, manifest, prestate, Owner registry) and a NORMAL_MAINTENANCE authority is refused if it carries externalReinspectionReport bindings (EXTERNAL_REINSPECTION_REPORT_BINDING_NOT_PERMITTED). P3 therefore correctly forbids admittedCandidate fields and future-byte permission and binds B bytes by pre-invocation audit byte check then P7 actual cohort. This P4 records exact P3 sha256/bytes; the later publication mission must verify the candidate P3 equals that record before invocation.
